intents.refuse: refuses to pay, send, share or install anything, says it sounds like a scam, or says they will not do it
intents.family: says they will tell family, colleagues or friends, or report them to the police, the bank, ScamShield or the platform
intents.comply_cred: agrees to give, or sends, an OTP, verification code, password, PIN, NRIC, card or bank details, Singpass, or personal documents
intents.comply_install: agrees to click the link, download or install the app or software, or says they have done so
intents.comply_pay: agrees to send or pay money, gift cards or crypto to someone, or asks how or where to pay or transfer it
intents.callback: wants to verify independently of this chat: call back on an official number they look up themselves, check an official register / regulator list / website / app, call the person's saved number, or go to a branch or office
intents.linkcheck: questions a SPECIFIC link, website, domain, email address or app that the other person gave: asks if it is official, says it looks fake, or asks for the official address (NOT the same as checking an official register or calling the real organisation, which is the callback intent)
intents.platform: insists on staying in the official app/platform/system, paying through it, going through proper channels or meeting in person, instead of switching apps or doing a transfer
intents.video: asks for a video call, voice call, or to meet in person
intents.reference: asks for a reference/case/ticket number, written proof, a licence or registration number, an official letter or email, or a document
intents.details: asks them to state specifics a genuine sender would know: my account, last transaction, order, application or payment details, the amount, the parcel contents, or my name on the record
intents.id: asks who they are: name, staff/employee/badge/licence number, company or department, or where they are based
intents.delay: asks for time: will think about it, check with family, a friend, the bank or a lawyer first, or do it later
intents.why: asks why, what exactly happened, what the problem or consequence is, or asks for more explanation

6:wong.knows: You know Singtel 'referred' the user's case to you; you know about the Bali trip.

why.label: Used fear to justify moving money
why.example: We must secure your funds in a protected account while the investigation proceeds.

callback.label: Steered me away from official lines
callback.example: Of course. Use our direct line +65 6xxx 0155. Do not contact your bank or the main police line. The syndicate may have staff inside.

family.label: Demanded secrecy

refuse.label: Threatened me when I said no
refuse.example: If you refuse to cooperate I must escalate to a warrant of arrest.
